'''Iolite''' (Japanese: '''アイオライト''' ''Aioraito'') is the Japanese opening theme for the ''[[Rising Again]]'' arc and the sixth of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. It debuted in [[HZ115]], replacing [[GET BACK]].

The full version of the song was released as a [[List of Pokémon digital singles#Iolite|digital single]] on October 31, 2025, with the music video being released on November 1, 2025.

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
A lone star in the sky shines greatly before being covered by a flurry of clouds that act as a transition to the [[Brave Olivine]] flying in the sky. At the back of the ship, the sun shines on [[Liko]], [[Roy]], [[Dot]], and [[Ult]] with their respective partners and [[Captain Pikachu]]. On beat with the music, a still image of each member of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and their [[party]] is shown, starting with Liko and ending with [[Friede]]. Afterward, the series logo appears in front of a comet shooting across space. It then zooms out of [[Pagogo]]'s eye as Liko holds it while standing in a field with {{TP|Liko|Meowscarada}}, {{TP|Liko|Hatterene}}, and {{TP|Liko|Armarouge}}. Liko, Meowscarada, Roy, {{TP|Roy|Skeledirge}}, Dot, {{TP|Dot|Quaquaval}}, Ult, and {{p|Sableye}} jump together.

Friede's [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] {{p|Starmie|Instructor Starmie}} appears before joining its {{pkmn|Trainer}} and {{TP|Friede|Charizard}} on a path in space. [[Roy's Lucario]] exchanges blows [[Master Mayonnaise]]'s {{p|Hawlucha}}. At sunset, [[Amethio]] trains {{TP|Amethio|Ceruledge}} and {{p|Corviknight}} while [[Zirc]], [[Onia]], and their Pokémon watch. He then briefly turns to the camera before looking up, changing the focus to the [[White Zygarde]]. Liko and Armarouge walk together as she steps on a puddle. Roy, Ult, Lucario, and Sableye sit together, watching the cloudy sky. Dot and {{TP|Dot|Gholdengo}} stand together as gust of wind blows her hair while the sun comes out. While the sky changes according to the time of day, a series of overlays appear – an [[Auspicious Armor]], two hands with [[Mega Ring]]s exchanging fist bumps, Nidothing's ears, someone holding a [[Gimmighoul Coin]], a bunch of [[mochi]] filling the screen, someone holding a [[Strong Sphere]], a cluster of [[Laquium]] crystals, a silhouette of [[Indi]] and [[Rubina]] in front of the [[Explorers]] logo, and finally the [[Black Rayquaza]] looking up and gazing straight at the camera. Another series of still images appear, this time featuring the allies of the Rising Volt Tacklers alongside their Pokémon, followed by the Explorers and their Pokémon.

On the wing deck, at Liko's command, Meowscarada moves in to attack, followed by Armarouge and Hatterene. Roy joins in with his own command for Skeledirge, Mega Lucario, and {{TP|Roy|Kilowattrel}}. Dot is next, with Quaquaval, {{TP|Dot|Tinkaton}}, and Gholdengo. Ult goes next with Sableye and {{p|Dragonite|Mega Dragonite}} before Cap rushes at the camera with {{m|Volt Tackle}}. The camera then pans over Liko, Roy, Dot, Ult, [[Ann]], {{an|Nemona}}, and [[Penny]] as it changes into all their Pokémon standing together. [[Spinel]]'s {{p|Umbreon}} and Meowscarada battle each other. The Laquium Core is shown. The eighteen Terastallized Pokémon involved in the purification of the Laquium appear one by one as they fly to the sky over Laqua, later showing as one group when the camera zooms out. Liko is clutching a {{i|Poké Ball}} before a series of flashbacks of her appears, starting with her as a young child looking to the side, then in her [[Indigo Academy]] uniform briefly turning to the front, and finally in the present day looking directly at the camera. Liko, with Dot, Ult, Quaquaval, and Sableye behind her, faces Meowscarada, with Roy, Skeledirge, and Cap behind the {{pkmn|category|Magician Pokemon}}. The Brave Olivine then flies toward the horizon.

==Variants==
# [[HZ115]]: The original animation.
# [[HZ116]] - [[HZ118]]: The animation is updated to include {{an|Nemona}}'s {{DL|Nemona (anime)|Decidueye}}.
# [[HZ119]]: The animation is updated to include [[Liko's Hatterene]].
# [[HZ120]]: The animation is updated to include [[Roy's Skeledirge]].
# [[HZ121]]: The animation is updated to include [[Dot's Gholdengo]].
# [[HZ122]] - [[HZ123]]: The scene with [[Lacey]] is replaced by [[Friede]] (in his new clothes) running alongside {{TP|Friede|Charizard}} and {{DL|Friede|Instructor Starmie}}, while the scene with [[Drayton]] is replaced by {{TP|Roy|Lucario}} battling [[Master Mayonnaise]]'s {{p|Hawlucha}}. Lacey and Drayton battling is replaced by [[Liko's Meowscarada]] battling [[Spinel]]'s {{p|Umbreon}}, followed quickly by a silhouette of something unknown.
# [[HZ124]]: The animation is updated to include [[Diana]]'s {{p|Pecharunt}}.
# [[HZ125]]: The animation is updated to include [[Liko's Armarouge]] and the [[White Zygarde]] in its {{form|Zygarde|50% Forme}}.
# [[HZ126]] - [[HZ128]]: The scene with the [[Six Heroes]] is updated to show them, except for the [[Black Rayquaza]], battling in their {{Tera}}stallized states.
# [[HZ129]]: The animation is updated to include [[Dot's Quaquaval]].
# [[HZ130]]: The scene with the Six Heroes is updated to show the Black Rayquaza battling in its Terastallized state.
# [[HZ131]] - [[HZ132]]: The animation is updated to include [[Hamber]]'s {{DL|Hamber|Rotom|Mow Rotom}} and {{DL|Hamber|Ursaluna|Bloodmoon Ursaluna}}.
# [[HZ133]] - [[HZ136]]: Roy's Lucario and Master Mayonnaise's Hawlucha's battle scene is updated to show them as [[Mega Evolution|Mega Lucario Z and Mega Hawlucha]]. Liko's Meowscarada and Spinel's Umbreon battle scene is updated with the background clearly showing [[Laqua]], with the unknown silhouette revealing itself to be the [[Laquium|Laquium Core]]. The scene with the Terastallized Six Heroes is replaced by the eighteen Terastallized Pokémon involved in the purification of the Laquium flying to the sky over Laqua.
